title: Chapter 602 - 602 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest! (2)
content:
Chapter 602 - 602 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest! (2)

Chapter 602 - 602 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest! (2)

602 One Month; Golden Treasure Chest! (2)

UA: [No way, no way! Then wouldn’t Qiao Yashu become a muscular woman? God, no!]

…

In Japes’ live broadcast room.

Sen Mu: [Hashimoto obtained Copper Skin Iron Bones? He’s impenetrable now? Long live!]

Taro Ono: [In the future, only Hashimoto can fight the beasts and others. No one can harm him anymore!]

Ya Chen: [Long live Japes!]

…

In Bear Country’s live broadcast room.

TT: [Alan’s treasure chest is… Beginner Earthquake!]

Y: [Earthquake? Could it be that he can create an earthquake?]

Gulp: [An earthquake caused by human power? This is unbelievable!]

…

In Corea’s live broadcast room.

Li Zheng: [Hahaha! Li Jinxuan has obtained 500 Constitution points! How powerful is he now? He can definitely kill many ferocious beasts easily!]

Oppa: [Didn’t many people praise Lin Fan before? Our Li Jinxuan is probably not worse than him now! Maybe even stronger! This is 500 points of Constitution!]

Gold: [If only Li Jinxuan met Lin Fan. Maybe he could kill Lin Fan with one punch and avenge Li Xianhao!]

…

Almost every country’s live broadcast room was in an uproar.

When they saw their country’s heroes die one after another, causing the country’s resources, environment, and other aspects to continuously decline…

Everyone was in despair.

Now, they finally had a glimmer of hope.

The heroes of their own countries had obtained great power. In the future, they would no longer be afraid of the beasts of the Otherworld!

Through killing ferocious beasts and monsters to allow the country to obtain the corresponding resources…

Doomsday would not come!

…

Compared to the excitement of the other countries’ live broadcasts…

Hua Nation’s live stream was much calmer.

“Professor Lin didn’t seem to use the skill in the treasure chest,” Xiao Bing said. “Beginner Earth Manipulation Technique. Could it be the ability to control the earth?”

Take a Look: [I saw that the heroes of many countries on the foreign network have all obtained great power.]

Song: [Li Jinxuan of Corea has obtained 500 Constitution points. Now, many people in Corea say that Li Jinxuan can kill God Lin.]

On the Way Home: [Kill God Lin? This is probably the funniest joke I’ve ever heard.]

Mystery: Can Li Jinxuan withstand God Lin’s sword, or can he resist being frozen, or can he withstand lightning? I’m about to laugh myself to death! How dare a mere mortal compare to an immortal?]

No Deal, No Harm: [There’s no need to discuss Li Jinxuan at all. If we want to discuss, we should discuss the Heavenly Hound. I just want to say, why am I not the Heavenly Hound?!]

This sentence seemed to resonate with many people.

Then, the entire screen was filled with bullet comments.

Man in the Wind: [Why am I not the Heavenly Hound?!]

[Han Dynasty: [Why am I not the Heavenly Hound?!]

Servant: Why am I not the Heavenly Hound?!]

…

Countless people envied a dog.

It had to be said that this was indeed a little strange.

However, it was normal for such a situation to occur.

One had to know…

The Heavenly Hound had obtained many Constitution points, Beginner Fire Control, Beginner Light of Life, Beginner Earth Manipulation Technique, and many other skills.

As long as one obtained one of them, one would be a superhuman existence. How could this not make people envious?

…

After the heroes opened the treasure chests and experienced this magical power, an emotionless voice sounded in their ears again.

[Entering level-eight forbidden area.]

[Countdown, 10.]

[9!]

[8!]

…

When everyone heard this, they were at a loss.

None of them knew what the forbidden area was.

Meanwhile, the hearts of the audience in front of the screen tightened.

This was because everything was either broadcasted live or reported in the news. Most of them knew that there were extremely terrifying dangers in forbidden areas.

However, no matter what they thought, they could not stop the countdown.

[2!]

[1!]

As the last number fell, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam… as well as all the heroes in the Otherworld, suddenly disappeared from where they were.

In the next moment, they appeared in a relatively dark place.

Lin Fan removed his hand from the Heavenly Hound’s head and muttered, “Sure enough, I can bring the Heavenly Hound in. Is this a level-eight forbidden area?”

He first silently sensed the changes in his body. He realized that this level-eight forbidden area was not like the mangroves that constantly absorbed the energy in his body. It was as if he had just changed his environment, and there was no other difference.

“Amazing!” Sam said excitedly. “Master, we suddenly came here! It was just like when he came from Earth.

“Master, is this the legendary Heaven and Earth Great Shift?!”

The Heaven and Earth Great Shift?

Lin Fan’s mouth twitched, but he did not explain anything.

He randomly found a direction and said, “Let’s go.”

There might be many terrifying beasts and monsters in the forbidden area.

However, Lin Fan did not care at all.

In other words, he was looking forward to it.

That was because this meant that he could obtain more treasure chests and red packets.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam did not walk for long before they heard a sound from the forest not far away.

Sam immediately became alert. He clenched his fists and stood in front of Lin Fan.

Clearly, he was prepared to help Lin Fan fend off any danger.

Even though his actions were useless, Lin Fan still nodded his head silently.

In the next moment…

A man with a face covered in dust and wearing tattered clothes walked out of the forest.

When Sam saw that it was a human, he heaved a sigh of relief and said in English, “Hello, I’m Sam from Bai Nation. Who are you?”

The bearded man stuttered in English, “I am Hashimoto Musashi from Japes.”

Then, he started to look at Sam and Lin Fan.

When Hashimoto Musashi saw the backpack behind Sam and the exposed roasted meat, his turbid eyes immediately lit up.

In the live broadcast room in Japes.

Feng Xingzi: [Is this the forbidden area? It’s so dark. It looks so scary.]

Ikeda: [That’s… Lin Fan! Hashimoto has met Lin Fan from Hua Nation!]

Natsuki: [Hashimoto, don’t make Lin Fan your enemy…]

Tanabe: [Don’t worry too much. Hashimoto has obtained Copper Skin Iron Bones. Even Lin Fan shouldn’t be able to cause too much damage to Hashimoto. Furthermore, Hashimoto might not even fight Lin Fan.]

Moriguchi: [Hashimotoseems to be touching a gun!]

As soon as he said that, the comments suddenly stopped.

Everyone was focused on the live broadcast.

…

As the Japes audience expected, Hashimoto Musashi was indeed touching his gun.

“Don’t move!”

Hashimoto Musashi revealed his yellow teeth and pointed his gun at Sam and Lin Fan.

“Don’t move! Now, slowly put the bag behind you on the ground.”

Sam had obtained 20 Constitution points and a gigantization skill. He had become a superhuman existence.

However, when he saw the black muzzle, a thin layer of sweat could not help but appear on his forehead.

Terrifying!

This was definitely the most terrifying thing he had faced!

Thus, Sam did as he was told and slowly placed the backpack on the ground.

Hashimoto Musashi nodded in satisfaction. Such a big bag of meat was enough for him to eat for a long time!

Then, he accidentally discovered that there was an animal that looked like a wolf or a dog at the side. His eyes lit up again.

“I didn’t expect there to be a living animal! This way, I won’t have to worry about food for a month!”

As he spoke, he could not help but swallow.

Lin Fan acted as if he did not see the gun pointed at him.

His expression remained the same. He looked down at the Heavenly Hound beside him and said, “That person wants to eat you.”

When the Heavenly Hound heard this, it roared toward the sky, revealing its ferocious appearance.

Then, it rushed toward Hashimoto Musashi.

It was so fast!

It was so fierce!

Hashimoto Musashi was shocked and hurriedly fired.

However, there was no effect.

When he saw the sharp claws of the Heavenly Hound coming at him, he hurriedly turned his skin bronze.

[Skill: Copper Skin Iron Bones!]
